name: duskfront
description: DUSKFRONT / جبهة الغسق — 3D web war game on a slowly rotating planet

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @duskfront/server && npm run build -w @duskfront/client
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n shared,server,client -c magenta,yellow,cyan "npm:dev:shared" "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @duskfront/shared && npm run typecheck -w @duskfront/server && npm run typecheck -w @duskfront/client
scripts.start:e2e:web: npm run build -w @duskfront/client && vite preview --config apps/client/vite.config.ts --port 4173 --host 127.0.0.1
